reason: A kitchen and household assistant centered on meal planning, inventory, dietary profiles, and related workflows through a persistent web UI board and chat agent.

summaries.zh: 为家庭提供集膳食规划、库存管理、饮食目标和厨房信息于一体的厨房与生活助手。
summaries.en: A kitchen and household assistant for meal planning, inventory management, dietary goals, and related home information.

capabilities: Reads and writes plain Markdown data in a session workspace
Stores household, dietary, inventory, equipment, and health-profile information
Provides an agent preset and domain skills for kitchen assistance
Generates recipe cards and performs health analysis on user-provided information
Adds a persistent Kitchen board and theme settings to the DSH Web UI
